description.value: Whole Foods Market's Robson Street location is a full-service natural and organic supermarket in Vancouver's West End, steps from Stanley Park. The store features in-house eateries including a coffee bar, juice bar, sandwich counter, and a hot and salad bar — making it a solid stop for cyclists looking to restock or grab a hot meal. Grocery delivery via Instacart and Amazon Prime savings are also available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 40m; stands (2 spaces) at 42m; stands (2 spaces) at 64m; stands (5 spaces) at 82m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the store is open at 1675 Robson St, Vancouver, BC V6G 1C8 with phone (604) 687-5288, matching OSM tags exactly. The website lists a Hot & Salad Bar ('customizable seasonal entrées, salads and sides'), a WFM Coffee Bar, Juice Bar, and sandwich counter, confirming hot food availability. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities on the website; OSM has no relevant bike tags either.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible supermarket with confirmed contact details and in-store eateries; a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists in Vancouver's West End.

Hot food.detail: Website lists a 'Hot & Salad Bar' with 'customizable seasonal entrées, salads and sides with keto- and paleo-friendly options', plus a WFM Coffee Bar and sandwich counter

wow_evidence: coffee bar, juice bar, sandwich counter, and a hot and salad bar
